messages:
sara.product: Quick sync on API surface + rate limit / pricing alignment for launch. high level: we need per-route semantics (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool calls) and clear token accounting rules.

mike.eng: +1. Can we list concrete rules we want to enforce at GA? e.g., per-API-key per-route qps, token-based quota, burst window, soft vs hard enforcement.

kevin-pricing: From pricing side: charging by token is primary. But customers expect predictable per-route caps (embeddings heavy). Proposal: bill embeddings as "embedding-units" (1 req = n units depending on vector length) and chat/completions billed per input+output tokens.

olivia-ux: We need simple docs examples: "How tokens map to charges" and a calculator widget. Also show how tool/function calling affects token counts (prompt + tool args + tool output).

mike.eng: Important technical bits: streaming responses should accumulate tokens as they emit. Function/tool calls: count tokens of the request, the tool call arguments, and the tool's output (we should attribute tool output tokens to the original route).

kevin-pricing: Edge case: retries and partial responses. We should only bill for tokens actually generated/served. Retries due to 5xx should not bill twice if we dedupe by request id.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: rate-limiter config default: 100 qps per-key per-route, burst 2x for 30s, token-quota enforcement nightly reset; alert on 90% usage.

mike.eng: Implementation notes: quota enforcement levels: 1) soft limit (429 warning header + usage UI) 2) hard limit (reject with 429) 3) queuing option for Dedicated customers. Need feature flag to toggle per-tenant.

kevin-pricing: Launch criteria (pricing & limits): a) docs + calculator live, b) telemetry that breaks down cost-per-route, c) billing events validated on sandbox with synthetic workloads, d) tool-calls token attribution verified.

tariq-ml: For rerank: we should offer both: cheap per-candidate embed-score (low unit cost) and full rerank (higher cost). Rerank API should expose a "candidate_count" field that factors into pricing model and quotas.

olivia-ux: UX: quota UI should show both token spend and per-route qps usage; allow customers to set per-route hard caps and alerts. Also clarify behavior when multiple caps interact (route cap vs account token quota).

mike.eng: Logging + meters: every request should emit: request_id, route, tenant_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_tokens, billing_units, rate_limit_action. We'll need that for disputes and billing.

kevin-pricing: Pricing alignment: offer 3 presets: dev (generous soft limits), standard (balanced), enterprise (strict hard limits + dedicated quotas). Each preset maps to default per-route qps and token quotas.

sara.product: Scope negotiation: MVP GA: enforce per-route qps + token accounting + docs + billing events. Defer per-tenant queuing, advanced burst tuning, and quota UI controls to post-GA. If everyone agrees, I'll write the PRD with launch criteria above.

mike.eng: Agree. I'll open an RFC for the rate-limiter implementation with the telemetry contract and sample headers: `X-RI-RateLimit: 240/60` and `X-RI-Request-ID`.

kevin-pricing: I'll draft the pricing table and the embedding-unit definition.

olivia-ux: I'll mock the quota UI and the docs snippets this week.

sara.product: Great — target PRD complete by EOD Friday. If blockers pop up, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance windows may affect burst tests on 2024-06-15 02:00-04:00 UTC.
